issues.description: The problem statement requires that the subroutine set_pixel must not modify any registers except EAX ("Außer dem Register eax dürfen keine anderen Registerinhalte verändert werden"). However, the template file contains a contradictory comment at the position where students are instructed to calculate the position: ";Attention: save all registers you modify except eax,ebx and esi" which implies EBX and ESI need not be preserved. The solution implementation of set_pixel also preserves EBX/ESI via push/pop (contradicting the template comment). This mismatch between the problem specification and the template comment can confuse students about which registers must be preserved and what contract set_pixel must follow.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the register-preservation requirement consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the template comment to match the problem statement (explicitly state that set_pixel must preserve all registers except EAX), or (B) if the intended rule is that EBX/ESI may be clobbered, update the problem statement to allow modifying/preserving those registers and document the calling convention precisely. Also ensure the example solution and any in-template guidance use the same convention.
